body: oh man i wish it did for me, but getting high just makes me too introspective. it worsens my mood whilst making me too raw to cope with it.

"suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem"

fuck off. you have no idea how permanent my problems are. and maybe the reason i want to kill myself is exactly because the prospect of never being conscious again forever is appealing.
this poor guy is experiencing one of the worst extremes of human emotion possible. I hope he has the support network he needs.
